messages:
marta: Heads upI found a confusing mismatch in the API reference for the /embed endpoint. The request examples show a top-level `metadata` object in one snippet and a `metadata: {}` inline in another. Customers are asking if metadata is optional or required.
ken: Which files? Link please.
marta: sources/api-reference/embed.md (example A) vs SDK snippets in /samples/embed-js.md (example B). Example A has 
```json
{
  "input": "text",
  "metadata": null
}
```
Example B has no metadata field at all.
ryan: From runtime, metadata is optional. It should be omitted when empty. But our guideline for examples is to show empty objects {} instead of null to avoid languages that collapse null into nil.
li: Docs convention historically: omit optional fields in minimal snippets, but use explicit empty object in fuller examples. That inconsistency is confusing.
marta: My proposal: change the API reference examples to omit metadata in minimal request sample, and show explicit {} in the 'complete' sample. Also add a short note: 'metadata is optional; send an object if you have key-values, otherwise omit the field.'
ken: Sounds good. Also check TypeScript SDK snippet: it currently passes metadata: undefined which serializes differently in node fetch vs browser. Recommend examples use `metadata: {}` in SDKs when demonstrating how to attach metadata.
ryan: Agree. For server-side samples we should prefer {} to show shape. For minimal quickstart snippets omit it.
docs-bot: Action items recorded: update embed.md minimal example to drop metadata, update full example to use {}, adjust JS/TS snippet to use {} when demonstrating metadata usage, leave Ruby example comment about nil vs {}. Ticket DOCS-512 created.
marta: I'll open a PR with the edit. Assigning ken to review SDK snippet changes because they touch samples used by codegen.
en: (typo meant ken)
ken: reviewing now. One tiny nit: add a one-line migration note for partners that earlier SDK versions might send `null` for absent metadata; encourage upgrade.
ryan: I'll add a note to the runtime compatibility doc clarifying no behavioural change, but that proxies can drop null fields.
marta: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1499. Includes minimal + full examples, cURL, JS and TS snippets.
ken: left a comment suggesting to swap order of examples and to add a caption.
marta: addressed comments and pushed fix.
ken: LGTM. Merging now.
docs-bot: Merged by ken. Notifying #release-notes for a short entry.
li: Great. After merge can we run a quick sweep to ensure other endpoints aren't showing metadata as null in examples? I can run a grep and make a list.
marta: Yes, good call. I ran grep and made a small list: /api-reference/search.md, /api-reference/ingest.md, /samples/embed-ruby.md. I'll open follow-up PRs.
li: Thanks. Small consistency wins are helpful.
ryan: Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
